faq: Which tools do you use for the numbers?
Your Shopify analytics and reports, plus Google Analytics if it is already connected. We do not buy or add data from other sources, and we only read the figures your store already holds.
Do you need full admin access?
Staff access with permission to view reports and orders is enough. We do not need to edit products or settings, and we never need your login details.
Will you tell me what to do with the numbers?
Yes. Every report finishes with three plain actions, such as which slow product to rework or which discount to stop. We say where the data is thin, so you do not act on weak evidence.
This is a one-off report in a fixed package. If you want one every month, ask us for a monthly quote, and we reuse the same layout so you can compare month to month.
